exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the words and their definitions.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">an open or closed box which consists of wooden slats: </font>[crate]<font color="#000000"></font>
<font color="#000000">to secure a load e.g. with a rope: </font>[strap]<font color="#000000"></font>
<font color="#000000">to stop from taking place: </font>[prevent]<font color="#000000"></font>
<font color="#000000">a large bundle of press-packed goods: </font>[bale]<font color="#000000"></font>
<font color="#000000">to be greater in number or quantity than expected or permitted: </font>[exceed]<font color="#000000"></font>
<font color="#000000">to be chosen for a task: </font>[appointed]<font color="#000000"></font>
